title: US Completes Withdrawal of Forces From Iraq
detail: The United States completed its withdrawal of forces from Iraq as the balance of regional power shifts further toward Iran following the seven-month conflict. The pullout marks a significant strategic realignment in the Middle East, with Iran now positioned as the dominant regional power, according to Washington Post reporting.

title: Iran Appeals to American Voters as US Troops Complete Iraq Exit
detail: Iran is appealing directly to American voters as US troops complete their exit from Iraq, seeking to shape public opinion in the United States amid ongoing tensions over the conflict. The influence campaign signals Tehran's effort to leverage the US withdrawal to strengthen its diplomatic position.

media.caption: Iran appeals to American voters as US troops complete Iraq withdrawal

title: UK PM Cites 'Strong Indications' of Iranian Plot Targeting English Military Base
detail: UK Prime Minister cited 'strong indications' of Iranian involvement in a plot targeting a military base in England, sharply escalating diplomatic tension with Tehran. The incident marks a significant extension of Iran's alleged covert operations into British territory and prompted calls for further sanctions and expulsions.

title: 19th US Military Death Reported Since Start of Iran War
detail: A Black US Army officer has become the 19th confirmed American military death since the Iran war began, raising the Pentagon's official KIA count to at least 19. The milestone adds to growing domestic pressure over US casualties in the conflict.
